# `role_assignment`

Grant of a role to a membership for a scope and a business-date interval. State contract: docs/architecture/workflows/role-assignment.md.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Owner module | platform |
| Kind | effective-dated-fact |
| Tenant scope | Tenant scoped: `tenant_id` + row-level security, composite keys/FKs |
| Runtime access | Granted to runtime roles (see migration grants) |
| Effective / recorded time | `effective_from`, `effective_to`, `recorded_at` |
| Retention class | `identity-access`: Access records kept for security review after revocation. Period: not yet decided. |
| API mapping | /v1/role-assignments (planned) |
| Write path | platform repository assignRole / endRoleAssignment. |
| Migration behaviour | Created in 0002_identity_org (expand). Further RBAC-03 scope dimensions arrive as nullable columns in a later expand migration. |

## Constraints

- PK (tenant_id, id)
- FKs to membership, role, legal_entity within the same tenant
- scope_type tenant <=> scope_legal_entity_id is null
- effective_to >= effective_from
- no overlapping interval for the same membership, role and scope (exclusion constraint)
- assignee cannot be the acting user (insert or update)
- only effective_to and version are updatable
- optimistic version
- audit required
